rationale: The candidate is a coherent stepped bar/compact mass across all four views, so it is readable and repairable as a single dominant gesture. The silhouette is not arbitrary in itself; the stepped section is consistent in plan, elevation, and axonometric. However, the visible mass under-delivers on the program's active-ground and public-void requirements: the carve is shallow and the street edge reads mostly sealed rather than publicly opened. The form also leans more toward a generic stacked object than a neighborhood living building with a legible threshold, so the program fit is only moderate. It passes because the mass is still plausible for the brief and the contradiction is one of under-articulated public ground rather than typological failure.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped prismatic massing can read as a coherent compact mixed-use figure when the section is clear and the upper setbacks remain secondary to a dominant base.
